Package org.eclipse.csi.codesign

Record Class GitHubActionsContext

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.eclipse.csi.codesign.GitHubActionsContext
Record Components:
resultsUrl - the Actions results service URL (ACTIONS_RESULTS_URL), used to upload the workflow artifact
runtimeToken - the Actions runtime token (ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN), used to upload the workflow artifact
runId - the workflow run ID (GITHUB_RUN_ID)
repository - the owner/name of the repository (GITHUB_REPOSITORY)
gitHubToken - a GitHub token (GITHUB_TOKEN) SignPath uses to read the workflow run and download the artifact; it needs the actions: read permission
public record GitHubActionsContext(String resultsUrl, String runtimeToken, String runId, String repository, String gitHubToken) extends Record
The GitHub Actions job a signing request is submitted from, as required by SignPath's GitHub trusted build system.

SignPath signing policies with trusted build system verification only accept requests submitted through the SignPath GitHub connector: the artifact is first stored as a workflow artifact of the running job, and SignPath downloads it from GitHub together with the origin of the build. This record carries what both steps need.

  • Method Details

    • fromEnvironment

      public static GitHubActionsContext fromEnvironment(Function<String,String> environment) throws CodesignException
      Reads the context from environment variables.

      GITHUB_RUN_ID and GITHUB_REPOSITORY are set for every step of a GitHub Actions job. ACTIONS_RESULTS_URL and ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN are only given to JavaScript and container actions, so a run: step has to receive them from such an action. GITHUB_TOKEN has to be passed explicitly, e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}.

      Parameters:
      environment - looks up an environment variable, returning null when unset (e.g. System::getenv)
      Returns:
      the context
      Throws:
      CodesignException - if any of the variables is unset or blank; the message names all of them
